# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU, Nano Server fonts, perf**

## Highlights

Adds the Graphite GPU backend, Nano Server FreeType fonts, and multiple allocation-free performance improvements. ramezgerges contributes Graphite backend bindings spanning Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. jeffska adds FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server containers, closing a long-standing gap. A new Vulkan Silk.NET package, async pixel reads, and several managed-layer perf wins complete the release.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream stability fixes** — Three rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges keep the bundled engine in sync with Skia's stable branch. ([#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New bindings expose the Graphite rendering backend across all three GPU APIs, giving consumers access to SkiaSharp's next-generation GPU path alongside the existing Ganesh backend. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A backend-neutral async pixel-read API lets GPU-resident images and surfaces deliver pixel data without blocking the render thread. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET NuGet package** — A dedicated package wires SkiaSharp's Vulkan backend to the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings, simplifying setup for consumers already using Silk.NET. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Deterministic binding generation** — Binding generation now produces identical output regardless of the host platform, making reproduced builds byte-for-byte consistent across Windows, macOS, and Linux. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path** — When the native raster image creation failed after allocating the pixel buffer, the unmanaged memory was not freed. The leak is now plugged. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Windows native build MSVC environment initialized once** — The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once per native build session instead of once per target, avoiding redundant shell overhead on Windows CI. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support for Windows Nano Server** — Nano Server containers can now render text using a bundled FreeType font engine, closing a long-standing gap (issue #1105) for server-side headless rendering. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — New CI legs run the SkiaSharp test suite inside Docker containers targeting Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server, verifying the native assets on these platforms. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Solution format migrated to .slnx** — All SkiaSharp solution files are converted to the new XML-based .slnx format, reducing merge conflicts and improving IDE load times. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKData.SaveTo no longer copies through a double buffer** — The previous implementation copied the data into an intermediate byte[] before writing; it now writes directly from the native buffer, halving memory traffic for large saves. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms and GetEncodedText allocation-free** — The uniform lookup map is pre-sized to the known count, and the null-terminated GetEncodedText path avoids an intermediate string allocation, reducing per-call heap pressure. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
